name: 26502-batchdecode-gemma4-26ba4b-tp2
model: google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it. Public and UNGATED, ~48.1 GiB of bf16 safetensors, served unquantized in the checkpoint's own dtype.
hardware: 2x H100 80GB HBM3 of one a3 node.
parallelism: TP=2, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1 -- 48.1 GiB of weights does not leave a usable KV pool on one 80 GB card.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup the first 20% and cooldown the last 10%, bounded at 640 requests with a 2400 s safety cap. 448 requests are measured.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, one turn per request: exactly 1024 prompt tokens and exactly 1024 output tokens, both stdev 0, no shared prefix, temperature 0, `ignore_eos`.
purpose: A long-form drafting assistant on two GPUs, writing 1024-token replies to 1024-token prompts for 64 concurrent users.
launch:
# The launch line: sglang at the commit named by configs/setupcard.md `commit_id`.
#
# Flat `key: value` only -- an indented block is SKIPPED by the reader, so a re-flowed value is
# silently dropped and the engine starts without it. A bool is a FLAG: `true` emits `--key`,
# `false` emits nothing. Everything not written here is a stock default of the pinned commit.

model-path: google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it
tp-size: 2
attention-backend: triton
dtype: bfloat16
mem-fraction-static: 0.55
context-length: 4096
disable-radix-cache: true
